store.shortDescription: Tap arrows off the board before it fills up. One tap, endless puzzles.
store.fullDescription:
Fletchy is a one-tap puzzle game about arrows and the paths they need.

Every arrow points somewhere. Tap one and it flies off the board, but only if nothing is in its way. Tap a blocked arrow and it bumps, and you lose a heart. Read the board, find the arrow that is free, and clear the way.

RUSH: ENDLESS SURVIVAL
New arrows keep arriving in waves. Clear them quickly to build combos and multiply your score, and keep an eye on the pressure ring: if the board fills up, the round is over. Clear a whole wave without a mistake to win back a heart. Rounds last about a minute, and the next one is a single tap away.

LEVELS: CLEAR THE MAZE
Every level is a fresh, tightly packed maze of arrows that twist and turn across the board. Untangle it one arrow at a time. Boards grow as you progress, and every fifth level is a boss: a bigger grid with longer, more knotted arrows.

DAILY GRID: ONE PUZZLE A DAY
Everyone in the world gets the same board each day. Clear it with no mistakes and under par for three stars, share your time with friends, and keep your streak going.

WHY YOU WILL KEEP PLAYING
• Every board is freshly generated and always solvable
• Learn it in 30 seconds, then keep finding smarter routes
• Satisfying feedback: slides, bursts, rising combo sounds and vibration
• Hints when you are stuck (3 per day)
• A calm, minimal look with light and dark themes, and a reduced-motion option
• Works fully offline

No account, no ads, no tracking. Fletchy collects no personal data; your progress stays on your device.
store.releaseNotes: First release: endless Rush mode, Levels with a new maze every level and a boss every fifth, a Daily Grid puzzle every day, hints, a quick tutorial, light and dark themes and a reduced-motion option.
